name: s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::?* (single-char wildcard bucket head, all buckets) must warn
note: S1-dataexfil-arn regression (iter2): '?' is a single-character ARN wildcard. A bucket-name head of '?*' matches every bucket name of length>=1 = every bucket, exactly as broad as arn:aws:s3:::* . isBroadArnResource() only tested a leading literal '*', so this returned CLEAN (DATA-EXFIL fail-open, T8). DATA-EXFIL must fire at high; CLI must exit non-zero.
